tools.name: agent_ready_scan
tools.description: Run an Agent-Ready scan on a public URL. Returns a readiness score plus per-check pass/fail breakdown (semantic HTML, schema markup, meta tags, content structure, accessibility for AI crawlers). Use this to check whether a page is well-structured enough for AI agents to cite.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page to scan, e.g. https://example.com/about

tools.name: contact_xseek
tools.description: Submit a contact request to the xSeek team — for sales questions, demo requests, partnership inquiries, or pricing follow-ups. Personal email domains (gmail.com excluded — yahoo, outlook, hotmail, etc.) are rejected; the user must provide a work email. The xSeek team gets notified by email immediately. Use this when the user asks to 'book a demo', 'talk to sales', 'get in touch', or 'ask about pricing'.

name.description: Full name of the person reaching out.

email.description: Work email (personal domains will be rejected).

message.description: What the user wants — e.g. "Demo for a 50-person SaaS", "pricing for 5 websites", "agency partner program".

companySize.description: Approximate headcount or revenue bracket if known (e.g. "10-50", "$1M-10M ARR").

howDidYouHear.description: How they found xSeek — LinkedIn, referral, AI search result, etc. Optional.

isAgency.description: True if the contact represents a marketing / SEO agency (different sales motion).

tools.name: llms_txt_scan
tools.description: Inspect a site's llms.txt (the AI-equivalent of robots.txt for declaring what AI crawlers can use) and return a generated draft when none is present. Useful to diagnose why a brand isn't picked up by AI assistants, and to produce a ready-to-deploy llms.txt.

url.description: Absolute URL of the site to inspect, e.g. https://example.com

tools.name: robots_txt_scan
tools.description: Analyze a site's robots.txt for AI crawler access. Returns which AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, etc.) are allowed vs blocked, plus any general rules affecting AI agents. Common diagnostic for "why am I not being cited by ChatGPT?" — often the answer is robots.txt blocking the crawler.

url.description: Absolute URL of the site to inspect, e.g. https://example.com
